notes: The finish is the one trigger_teleport aimed at `tesqend` -- a 40x40 pad in a magenta room at the end of the last level, which puts the player in the end room directly beneath the start room (the two are stacked at [-4200 4300], floors z 2000 and 2272; the GameBanana page apologises for both). Nothing else aims at `tesqend`. The start is the upper room: all 40 spawns are in it, and its only way out is an 8x352 door teleport between the env_laser gate at x -4000 and the destination `s1l1`. The page says the map is '9 mpbhop levels', and the door teleports give exactly nine in a single chain: spawn -> s1l1, s1 -> `s2` (134x8), s2 -> `js1l1` (96x96; js1 is Jagg's stage, JAGG on the credits), js1 -> `s3l1` (40x128), s3 -> `s4l1` (40x40), s4 -> `s5l1` (48x40), s5 -> `s6enter` (72x72), s6 -> `s7l` (64x64), s7 -> `s8l1` (400x7), s8 -> `tesqend`. Those arrival points are the stages. The pits do not return a player directly: each sends to a cell `sNcM` in a grid at [-3560..-3224 -1376..-1232 1984], and a 32x32 teleport in the cell sends on to the level point `sNlM`; the `doorways` rule reads the level doors and the cells alike, which is harmless because nothing reaches a cell once the pits respawn.
